title: A Meal
label: ch:ka-a-meal
canDo: I can say I am having a meal in Kannada, using the word Chapter 32 used once and never explained, and place it at the hour of two greetings I already know.

payoff.summary: Say ಊಟ ಮಾಡು, explain ūṭa against everyday tinnu, read the independent vowel ಊ, and place the word at the hour of ಶುಭ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ and before ಶುಭ ರಾತ್ರಿ.
